title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity

title: SDE II, Last Mile
description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components. Senior Engineers provide technical leadership at Amazon. They help establish technical standards and drive Amazon’s overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies. They work on our hard problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. They think globally when building systems, ensuring Amazon builds high performing, scalable systems that work well together. Senior engineers are pragmatic visionaries who can translate business needs into workable technology solutions. Their expertise is deep and broad. They are hands on, producing both detailed technical work and high\-level architectural designs.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust
description:
**Senior Rust Software Engineer (Desktop Native)**
 Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that “we are all in this together” – we continue to offer a full\-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise\-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.
   

  

 As a Senior Rust Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will own desktop autofill and native OS integrations, including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration, built on the same cross\-platform Rust SDK that also powers browser autofill. This role is primarily for someone strong in Rust, FFI and language bindings, and native OS\-level integration on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with the unusual challenge of delivering secure, reliable native experiences on top of a zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end encrypted product. This is not primarily a front\-end or UI role.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Design, build, and maintain native desktop integrations including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration
* Participate in the hands\-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across desktop and browser clients
* Interface directly with OS\-level APIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux to deliver reliable native behavior.
* Improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of native integrations handling sensitive credential data.
* Partner with product, design, QA, and the Autofill team to deliver high\-quality experiences end to end.
* Review pull requests and help raise the quality of native/systems engineering, including community contributions in GitHub.
* Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring and architecture improvements to the Desktop Native roadmap
* Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
* Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes
* Occasionally review \& approve bug fixes submitted by the user community


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**
* Strong production Rust experience — 4\-6\+ years overall backend/systems experience, including FFI and language bindings
* Native desktop application experience, interfacing directly with OS\-level APIs on Windows, macOS, or Linux
* Experience designing and versioning cross\-platform SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple client surfaces
* Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
* Experience with Electron, TypeScript, and other web tech for cross\-platform desktop applications and web clients is a plus
* Collaborative and adaptable mindset
* Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution


**WHY WORK WITH US**
* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.
* At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self\-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description:
**Company Profile**
 Bain \& Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
   

  

 Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
   

  

 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
   

  

**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
   

  

 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are hiring a Software Engineer to solve real business problems for the functions that keep Bain running. From Finance to Legal, HR, Risk, and more you will build full\-stack software, AI agents,
 **integrations, and workflow products that turn messy, ambiguous business needs into reliable, working software. You will partner** 
 closely with the people who use what you ship ensuring it is correct, reliable, maintainable, and clearly communicated.
   

  

 This role suits high\-initiative builders with strong software fundamentals who treat AI as a force multiplier \- using it not only to deliver more, but to deliver faster, more efficiently, and to a higher standard.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
* You will work on real business problems with users close enough to give fast feedback.
* You will use AI development tools as part of the normal engineering workflow, not as a side experiment.
* You will be encouraged to compress the path from idea to working software without lowering the engineering bar.
* You will build across the stack: frontend, backend, data, APIs, integrations, and agentic workflows.
* You will be expected to ship quickly while still writing code that another engineer can understand, test, and extend.
* You will learn across domains instead of specializing only in one platform or one automation tool.


**What You Will Build**
* Internal tools that turn messy business processes into structured, trackable workflows.
* AI agents that draft, check, route, summarize, or monitor work with appropriate human review.
* Full\-stack applications for Bain teams that need reliable software, not one\-off scripts.
* Integrations across documents, tickets, databases, collaboration tools, and internal platforms.
* Prototypes that move quickly and can be hardened into maintainable production systems when the value is proven.


**Principal Accountabilities and % of time**
**Build full\-stack solutions (45%)**
 Own contained projects and features from problem clarification through launch. Build backend services, frontend interfaces, data models, APIs, integrations, and workflow logic that solve practical business problems.
   

  

**Use AI to accelerate delivery (20%)**
 Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Replit, or similar tools to plan, code, test, debug, document, and refactor. Validate AI output before it reaches users.
   

  

**Translate business ambiguity into software (15%)**
 Clarify user needs, prioritize MVP features, ask probing questions, and choose practical technical approaches. Partner with senior engineers on broader architecture, security, and production\-readiness decisions.
   

  

**Maintain quality and reliability (15%)**
 Write readable, modular code; add useful tests; debug issues across the stack; document important decisions; and support solutions after launch.
   

  

**Collaborate and learn(5%)**
 Work with business stakeholders, product owners, senior engineers, and other technology teams. Share reusable prompts, patterns, components, and lessons learned.
   

  

**What Good Looks Like**
* You can break down a broad business problem, define the first useful solution, and deliver a working result.
* You use AI tools fluently but do not outsource judgment to them.
* You can explain your code, debug it, test it, and improve it after feedback.
* You communicate trade\-offs clearly to both engineers and business users.
* You recognize when to keep a solution simple and when to ask for senior engineering guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**
* 3\-5 years of professional software development experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* A track record of shipping working software, whether in production roles, substantial internships, or serious personal projects.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools as part of a real engineering workflow, or clear evidence of adopting them quickly and responsibly.
* Comfort working through ambiguity, making pragmatic trade\-offs, and communicating clearly with both engineers and business users.


**Required**
* Strong coding fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, debugging, testing, and basic software design.
* Working ability in at least one general\-purpose programming language used for production software, ideally Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
* Familiarity with SQL, relational data modeling, web applications, REST APIs, Git, pull requests, and code review.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development tools, or clear evidence that you can adopt them quickly and responsibly.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, ask good questions, make pragmatic trade\-offs, and communicate clearly.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Svelte, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, or cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Experience integrating with enterprise systems and APIs such as Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, or Teams.
* Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, evals, prompt versioning, guardrails, memory, and human approval flows.
* Experience building internal tools, workflow products, business process software, or AI\-enabled applications.
* Exposure to Power Platform, RPA tools, n8n, Zapier, or Make is helpful but not required.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Gateway & Agentic AI Solutions
description:
**Senior Software Engineer \- AI Gateway \& Agentic AI Solutions (Azure / C\#)** 




**Experience: 12\-15\+ years overall engineering experience** 




**Engagement type: Client\-facing delivery role (engagement\-specific)** 




**Platform: Microsoft Azure Primary language: C\# / .NET** 




  





**Role Summary** 




  





 We're hiring a hands\-on senior engineer to do two connected things for client engagements: (1\) architect and build an Azure\-native AI Gateway \- functionally equivalent to a LiteLLM \+ Langfuse stack (multi\-model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, token/cost metering, tracing) \- and (2\) design and deliver multiple Agentic AI proof\-of concept scenarios in C\# using the Microsoft Agent Framework. This is an individual contributor role with direct client exposure, not a platform\-team or people\-management position.
 



  





 Top 5 Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Architect and implement the AI Gateway. Design and build an Azure\-native LLM gateway in C\# providing unified ingress across multiple model providers (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry models, and others) \- covering intelligent routing, fallback/load balancing, rate limiting and token\-quota enforcement, semantic caching, and centralized API key/secret management. Reference the LiteLLM feature set as the functional bar to hit.
 



  





 2\. Build the observability and governance layer. Implement request/response tracing, prompt/completion logging, token and cost metering, and latency dashboards \- the Langfuse\-equivalent half of the stack \- using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, and APIM's native LLM logging/token\-metric policies (or a self\-hosted Langfuse instance where warranted).
 



 3\. Deliver multiple Agentic AI PoC scenarios. Using C\# and the Microsoft Agent Framework, build a portfolio of distinct agentic patterns (single\-agent tool use, multi\-agent orchestration, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, RAG\-grounded agents) mapped to real client business use cases \- not one deep PoC, but several breadth covering scenarios that demonstrate different capabilities.
 



 4\. Own technical delivery on client engagements end\-to\-end. Run architecture proposals, hands\-on build, live demos, and production\-readiness assessments 1 directly with client technical stakeholders; translate ambiguous business asks into scoped, demoable agentic scenarios.
 



  





 5\. Package the work as reusable engineering assets. Turn the gateway and agent scenarios into templates, SDKs, or IaaC that can be re\-deployed across environments rather than rebuilt from scratch each time \- even though this is a client\-facing role, the artifacts should outlive any single client environment.
 



  





 Top 5 Required Skills / Background 1\. Deep C\#/.NET engineering background (12\-15\+ years). Production\-grade API/service development, async patterns, dependency injection, testing discipline, and comfort operating without a large surrounding platform team.
 



  





 2\. Hands\-on Azure platform expertise. Azure API Management (including GenAI/LLM\-specific policies: token\-limit, token\-metric, semantic\-caching), Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure Monitor / Application Insights, Key Vault, and either Azure Functions/App Service or AKS for hosting gateway services.
 



  





 3\. Working knowledge of LLM gateway and observability platforms. Familiarity with LiteLLM, Langfuse, or comparable tools (Portkey, Kong AI Gateway) \- not to operate them directly, but to translate their proven patterns (routing, fallback, semantic caching, token metering, tracing) into an Azure/C\# implementation.
 



 4\. Microsoft Agent Framework experience, or a direct path into it. Hands\-on work with MAF, or strong prior experience in Semantic Kernel and/or AutoGen (MAF's predecessors) \- multi\-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, thread/state management, and ideally MCP/A2A protocol exposure.
 



 5\. Client\-facing solution engineering track record. Demonstrated ability to architect, prototype, and present technical PoCs directly to enterprise client stakeholders, defend design trade\-offs live, and adapt scope under engagement time pressure.

description:
**Job Description**
**Position: Software Engineer II, Frontend** 
**Base Location: New Delhi** 
**Location:**

**About Chegg Skills**
 As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning." We build the applications and systems that help students make life\-changing career transitions into high\-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success.
   

  

 In this role, you will play a key role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed.
   

  

 Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post\-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student\- and educator\-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL\-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI\-powered learning features. You will also contribute across the stack as needed — this is a frontend\-first role with full\-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own frontend features end\-to\-end — architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring — across our student and educator web applications.
* Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client\-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on.
* Debug cross\-system issues that surface in the UI — GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches — by tracing root cause across the stack.
* Build AI\-powered learning features responsibly: validate model output before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry.
* Apply security and data\-protection practices — input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of user data — as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for.
* Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work.
* Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end\-to\-end), CI stability, and production validation.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Content Operations to deliver and harden high\-impact learner and educator workflows.
* Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews — including review of AI\-generated code — reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low.
* Ship end\-to\-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4\+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch.
* Strong hands\-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of web fundamentals — common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) — and the judgment to apply them without being told to.
* Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real\-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client\-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar).
* Strong testing and release\-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end\-to\-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
* Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce.
* Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with a CSS\-in\-JS styling approach and working alongside a component library (e.g., MUI).
* Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure — enough of a foundation to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when needed, even without prior production experience in those languages.
* Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application.
* Experience shipping AI\-powered UI — streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures.
* Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos.
* Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar).
* Experience in EdTech, e\-commerce, or another consumer\-facing product company.


**Tech Stack**
* Frontend: React (18/19\), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled\-components, MUI
* Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) — enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering
* Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, MSW
* Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI
* Observability: New Relic
* AI / ML: OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)


 Why do we exist?
   

  

 Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Senior Software Engineer - VOIP / SIP
description:
About the Company
 



 Practice by Numbers (PbN) is building medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market—software that helps dental teams run smoother, grow revenue, and improve patient experience. The platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation into a single system, replacing scattered tools and manual workflows trusted by thousands of practices across North America.
 



 PbN is mission\-driven and execution\-oriented: high ownership, tight cross\-functional collaboration, and product work with clear, measurable impact. You'll get real autonomy and see direct results in a large, under\-digitized healthcare vertical that's actively moving toward AI\-first workflows.
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 This role owns the design and implementation of PbN's core VoIP/SIP telephony backbone—the infrastructure layer that powers calling, routing, and communication workflows for thousands of dental practices. You will architect and build carrier\-grade SIP services in Golang on top of open\-source components, and integrate the telephony stack with PbN's broader AI\-first SaaS platform. The role reports to the Engineering India Head and sits at the intersection of deep infrastructure work and product\-facing impact.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Design and implement a carrier\-grade SIP/VoIP core using Kamailio or OpenSIPS for SIP signaling and FreeSWITCH or similar for media and application services.
* Build Golang\-based SIP services—registrar, SBC\-like components, routing logic, monitoring daemons—and internal APIs to control routing, policies, and provisioning.
* Configure and operate SIP load balancing, failover, and high\-availability setups across multi\-node SIP proxies, distributed media servers, and RTP proxies.
* Implement and maintain dial plans, least\-cost routing, DID management, class\-4/class\-5 switching logic, and integrations with upstream carriers and PSTN gateways.
* Own security and robustness of the VoIP stack: TLS/SRTP, authentication, rate limiting, fraud detection hooks, and abuse controls.
* Integrate the telephony backbone with PbN's SaaS platform via well\-defined internal APIs and webhooks, covering user accounts, billing, analytics, and AI/automation flows.
* Define and own monitoring, alerting, logging, and capacity planning for SIP signaling, RTP/media, and VoIP quality metrics (MOS, jitter, packet loss).



  





 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 7–10 years of software development experience with at least 4–5 years building or operating large\-scale VoIP/SIP systems in production.
* Strong Golang skills including high\-performance networked services, concurrent processing, and production\-grade APIs.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one open\-source SIP server—Kamailio, OpenSIPS, or Asterisk—including configuration, routing logic, and packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, SDP, NAT traversal, registrar/registration flows, B2BUA vs. proxy behavior, and SBC concepts.
* Proven ability to design and operate highly available telephony backbones: clustering, health checks, load balancing, and graceful failover.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals—iptables, firewalls, TCP/UDP, QoS—with comfort debugging at packet level using tcpdump or Wireshark.
* Experience integrating VoIP platforms with RESTful backends and databases (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) and message queues for control and billing workflows.



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with WebRTC, SIP over WebSockets, and browser or mobile softphone integrations.
* Familiarity with VoIP billing, rating engines, CDR processing, and reseller hierarchies (class\-4/class\-5 softswitch products or similar).
* Cloud\-native deployment of VoIP stacks—containerized Kamailio or FreeSWITCH clusters on AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, service meshes.
* Prior work building call center or CPaaS\-style platforms including programmable IVRs, call queues, and analytics.



  





 What We Offer
 


* End\-to\-end ownership of a mission\-critical infrastructure layer powering thousands of live dental practices across North America.
* Direct exposure to AI\-first product evolution—conversational automation, intelligent call routing, and front\-office workflow integration.
* High\-autonomy environment with tight cross\-functional collaboration across product, engineering, and operations.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with senior infrastructure expertise.
* Flexible scheduling within a fast\-moving, execution\-oriented team with real measurable impact.

description:

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

****Position Overview****
 The Senior SAP ABAP Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality SAP solutions across on\-premise and SAP BTP ABAP environments. The role focuses on building scalable, efficient, and maintainable applications, leveraging advanced ABAP techniques and modern programming models.
   

  

 As a technical lead, the developer collaborates closely with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust technical designs. They drive solution architecture, enforce development standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure performance optimization and clean\-core principles are followed across implementations.
   

  

 The role also involves developing advanced extensions and integrations using SAP BTP, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), and cloud\-native approaches. Additionally, the Senior ABAP Developer mentors junior team members, promotes best practices, and contributes to continuous innovation within the SAP landscape.
   

  

**Shift Timings: 01:00 \- 09:30PM IST**
****Description****
**Key Responsibilities**
* First level contact for the Business Analysts for any inquiries re: application or technical support and potential technical solutions.
* Analyzes business requirements and functional specifications to determine effective technical solutions to support the business across multiple entities (divisions, functions, countries)
* Provide technical solutions and governance for SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP solutions, ensuring compliance with architecture standards, development guidelines, and best practices.
* Designs complex solutions across multiple functions, business units, technical tools and/or systems.
* Designs, codes, tests, and implements new application programs and/or modifies existing programs.
* Considers trade\-offs between performance, scalability, reliability, availability, maintainability, manageability and business requirements.
* Provides post implementation application support and regular system maintenance and support which will periodically require evening, weekend, and on\-call support.
* Support new project initiatives as a Senior Developer, designing and building SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ABAP objects to meet business and technical requirements.
* Act as a senior technical authority, providing hands‑on guidance, problem resolution, and design support for complex development and integration scenarios.
* May function as Team and/or Project lead responsible for completion of project phase.
* Recommend and promote platform and industry best practices, including cloud‑ready development approaches and clean core principles


****Qualifications****
**Required Qualifications**
****Description****
 Level of Education and Discipline
   

  

 Bachelors or Maters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Certification and/or Licenses**
 SAP Backend Developer – ABAP Cloud
   

  

 SAP Backend Developer – Cloud Application Programming Model
   

  

 Any SAP Development Cloud related certification
   

  

****Experience \- Functional/industry/commercial Knowledge, Business Acumen****
* 5\-8 years of experience working in the SAP ecosystem (required)
* 5\+ years of hands‑on experience in SAP BTP ABAP development (required)
* Proven experience delivering and governing SAP ABAP solutions in large, complex enterprise environments
* Strong hands‑on expertise in:
* SAP S/4HANA ABAP development
* SAP BTP ABAP Environment
* SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)
* RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP)
* Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM)
* SAP Build
* SAP BTP Workflow
* Demonstrated understanding of modern programming paradigms and cloud‑based extension models


 Strong business and functional acumen, enabling translation of enterprise requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions
   

  

****Interpersonal Skills \- Leadership, Interactions, Communication, Influence****
 Ability to develop effective working relationships. Demonstrated organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Acts as a mentor within team and across GBS and proactively shares knowledge. Interacts with peers to manager. Interacts with peers to director (presents to and interacts with function heads and steering committees) Performs role in a professional manner with the ability to develop effective working relationships.
   

  

**Other Skills And HPO Competencies**
 The role demonstrates High Performance Organization (HPO) competencies, including:
   

  

* Values all People: Encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing, and trust
* Strategic Thinking: Balances BAU stability with project innovation and long‑term platform goals
* Influence: Drives adherence to standards and best practices
* Personal \& Team Leadership: Takes ownership and supports team capability growth
* Attracting \& Developing Talent: Actively enables skill development through coaching and hands‑on collaboration
* Innovation: Applies modern development models and tools where appropriate
* Business Savvy \& Acumen: Understands enterprise priorities, risk, and operational impact


 The role requires a deep understanding of clean core and extensibility, best practices, strong analytical and design skills, and experience in large, regulated enterprise environments. Success depends on balancing strategic governance with hands‑on technical contribution, along with strong documentation and technical review capabilities.
   

  

 McCormick \& Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

title: Software Engineer (Secrets Manager)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Engineers \& Senior Engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Secrets Manager team, you will lead the development of our dedicated secrets engine, machine\-to\-machine (M2M) authorization protocols, and developer\-focused CLI/SDKs. Looking ahead, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the core infrastructure that extends Secrets Manager into our next\-generation
 **AI Identity and Access** 
 management platform—securing ciphers, credentials, and API keys against the unique custody risks of autonomous AI agents and headless workloads.
   

  

 In alignment with our modern
 **True Ownership** 
 model, our engineers are "T\-shaped" professionals who own their services end\-to\-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership]. You will collaborate closely in a synchronous "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to design and ship elegant, secure, and resilient code.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Platform \& Feature Development: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance APIs, SDKs, and CLIs for Secrets Manager and our future AI Identity and Access security frameworks.
* Machine \& AI Identity Custody: Implement secure, zero\-knowledge machine authentication, scoped access tokens, and runtime secrets injection gateways that protect credentials from being exposed to parent AI models or local execution environments.
* Decoupled Architecture: Work within our Decoupled Platform Architecture to ensure Secrets Manager operates as a highly scalable, independent tenant using its own dedicated data stores and asynchronous event\-driven message networks.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the automated testing, deployment pipelines, and production SRE health of your team's services, participating in on\-call rotations and postmortem analyses to drive continuous operational improvement.
* Developer Usability: Build usable, highly developer\-friendly API endpoints, integration libraries, and comprehensive technical documentation to lower the friction of secrets enrollment and machine onboarding.
* Security \& Compliance: Proactively threat\-model new services, remediate security vulnerabilities, and ensure our secrets engine maintains our strict, audited compliance standards .


**WHAT YOU BRING**
* Overall Experience: 3\-6 years in Software Engineering
* Technical Stack: Strong proficiency and experience in AI\-Led Development in Rust, C\# / .NET, or TypeScript (our core Secrets Manager SDK is built in Rust).
* Identity \& Secrets Management: Practical experience designing or integrating machine identity platforms, vaulting services, OAuth/OIDC, or token\-based authorization structures (e.g., JWT, access tokens, API keys).
* AI/Agent Security Interest: Curiosity or experience with the security implications of AI agent architectures, large language model (LLM) memory isolation, or sandboxed execution environments.
* T\-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Experience writing robust automated integration tests, maintaining containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and using modern APM and SRE logging tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana) to monitor services in production.
* Cryptographic Foundations: Solid grasp of symmetric/asymmetric encryption, zero\-knowledge protocols, and OS\-level secure storage APIs.
* Collaborative Mindset: Excitement to work in a high\-velocity, outcome\-driven environment using rapid prototyping and data\-driven prioritization.
* Open Source \& Communication: Excellent written communication and a strong passion for open\-source software, developer tooling, and modern internet security.


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
